# The standard library must be imported. Built-ins are the one exception: they
# are dot-imported into every file implicitly, which is the only such magic.
! sngl check nostd.sngl
stderr 'undefined: text'

sngl check withstd.sngl
stdout 'withstd.sngl: ok'

# Built-ins need no import — types, their methods, and literals all resolve.
sngl check builtins.sngl
stdout 'builtins.sngl: ok'

# And cannot be imported: naming an ambient package would imply it were
# optional.
! sngl check importbuiltin.sngl
stderr 'always in scope'

# The alias form binds the same package under a name of the caller's choosing.
sngl check aliased.sngl
stdout 'aliased.sngl: ok'

# Lowercase stdlib components stay reachable through the alias in expression
# position too. The private-component filter that rejects lowercase names in an
# imported package must recognise the stdlib by package identity — keying it on
# the name "sngl" rejects every other alias here.
sngl check aliased_expr.sngl
stdout 'aliased_expr.sngl: ok'

# Raw platform elements are ambient for every platform alike. html is the one
# whose name the stdlib also declares (for html.frontend/html.backend), and it
# must not become the only platform whose elements need an import.
sngl check rawelem.sngl
stdout 'rawelem.sngl: ok'

# That filter still applies to a real user package.
! sngl check private.sngl
stderr 'unknown component "helper" in package w'

-- nostd.sngl --
component main {
    text(value="x")
}
-- withstd.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"

component main {
    text(value="x")
}
-- builtins.sngl --
component main {
    var n int = int.max(1, 2)
    var f float = float.sqrt(2.0)
    var s string = string.upper("hi")
    var c color = color.rgb(1, 2, 3)
    var d date = "2026-08-21"
}
-- importbuiltin.sngl --
import . "sngl://builtin"

component main {
    var n int = 1
}
-- rawelem.sngl --
component Foo() {
    html.marquee() {}
}

component Bar() {
    gtk4.GtkLabel(label="x") {}
}
-- aliased_expr.sngl --
import ui "sngl://std"

func render() => ui.text(value="x")

component main {
    ui.text(value="y")
}
-- private.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"
import w "widgets"

func render() => w.helper()

component main {
    text(value="x")
}
-- widgets/widgets.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"

component helper() {
    text(value="private")
}
-- aliased.sngl --
import ui "sngl://std"

component main {
    ui.text(value="x")
}
